marketing_description: The DeWALT DCD803B is a cordless high torque impact driver featuring a 1/2 in keyless metal chuck and a brushless motor. This tool has a voltage rating of 20 V and a speed rating of 1650 RPM. With its compact design and overall dimensions of 11.06 in length, 6.13 in width, and 5.6 in depth, it is a versatile addition to any toolkit.
